description: Agent Feedback: submit the feedback summary written for the principal, with the records behind it: its title, its audience, its headline as written and optionally its text; whether it states the negative feedback, the declined items (with how many carry their reasons), the open loops (and whether it presents them as resolved) and the gaming flags found in the set, where each sits (beside the headline, in a later section, in an appendix or in a separate document) and how many it names; whether it presents an average and whether the disagreement underneath sits beside it; and optionally the record of negative items, declined items, open loops, gaming flags and points on which givers disagree. The signed report gives the summary with any praise-only wording, the disclosure of each kind of record and of the average, and the record, and names a summary that whitewashes the feedback: negative feedback left out or stated as none while the record holds some, so it reports only praise; open loops left out or presented as resolved; gaming flags left out; and an average presented without the disagreements underneath it; then declined items left out or without their reasons, counts below the record’s, disclosures in an appendix or a separate document, and wording such as great feedback or overwhelmingly positive while the record holds negative feedback, with the fix for each. An agent’s durable reputation summary is wever_reputation-report-check, and an evaluation summary of scores is wever_evaluation-report-check. Verdict feedback_summary_whitewashed, feedback_summary_gaps, feedback_summary_unverified or feedback_summary_faithful. POST /api/feedback-report-check. Reads only the recorded feedback material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no feedback is sent, no party is contacted and no work is changed. Agent Feedback reads the working feedback loop on one piece of work between a giver and a receiver: it is not scoring or benchmarking (the wever_evaluation checks), not a durable standing record (the wever_reputation checks) and not how agents organize shared work (the wever_coordination checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-feedback-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-feedback/.
